subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: The 21st February will us to love our country. remain The 26th March the National Martyrs Day. inspire is Our nation the Independence Day. These days indebted to the martyrs of our country. now International Mother Language Day.
guide_solution: (a) The 21st February is the National Martyrs’ Day. (b) The 26th March is the Independence Day. (c) Our nation will remain indebted to the martyrs of our country. (d) These days inspire us to love our country. (e) 21st February is now International Mother Language Day.
